'''Bakko''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] whom after having been the first to join her, served as the chief advisor and [[General/Legends|general]] of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Hadiya]] during the [[Despot War]]. After the defeat of the [[Despot Army]] at the [[Battle of Tython]], Bakko was banished from his homeworld of [[Shikaakwa]] and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] on [[Nox (planet)|Nox]] with the other generals of Hadiya's inner circle.
